concept.title: Engine coolant
concept.shortdesc: The high-pressure cooling system has a reservoir filled with year-round antifreeze coolant. The reservoir is filled at the factory.

conbody.p: Check the antifreeze protection and coolant level at least once a year (at the beginning of the winter season), and before traveling to a colder climate.

li.p: When the engine overheats due to low engine coolant, suddenly adding engine coolant may cause cracks in the engine. To prevent damage, add engine coolant slowly and in small quantities.
Do not drive without engine coolant. This may cause water pump failure, engine seizure, and so on.
